messages:
sam.sales: Passing to CS + eng for SentinelGov trial (POC: priya@sentinel.gov). Trial started today (30d). They flagged failures delivering audit webhooks and SAML missing 'agency_id'. They also asked for Private deployment pricing vs Dedicated. Ticket #67001 opened.

julia.cs: I'll own CS. Success criteria: SSO (email + agency_id), webhook delivery >=99.5%, and clear KMS requirements. Can sales attach the raw payloads?

sam.sales: Attached payloads to ticket 67001. Error seen: {"error":"MsgSizeExceeded"}. Priya prefers Private but will review Dedicated cost.

neil.support: Picking up #67001. Quick triage: edge proxy returns 500/413 on large posts (>1MB). Short-term ask: request gzip or chunking from client. Long-term: increase proxy limit or support streaming ingestion. I added repro curl to ticket.

arun.eng: cc @neil.support @julia.cs  I can scope fixes. If repro present: config bump ~24h; streaming path ~48-72h. If Private requested, infra lead time ~3w. Please add exact curl repro:
```
curl -v -X POST https://audit.sentinel/collect -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @sample.json
```
and include compressed option header.

julia.cs: Owner matrix: CS=@julia.cs, Support=@neil.support, Eng=@arun.eng, Sales=@sam.sales, Finance=@lina.finance. Action items: 1) Support attach repro + logs; 2) Eng scope hotfix; 3) Finance prepare two-option estimate (Private vs Dedicated); 4) CS schedule enablement call to walk SAML attrs and KMS checklist.

lina.finance: I'll draft a ballpark two-option estimate and post by EOD tomorrow. Private one-time fee + monthly infra vs Dedicated reserved monthly.

ops-bot: Ticket #67001 created by neil.support. SLA flagged: 24h response needed. :rotating_light:

julia.cs: Booked sync with Priya for tomorrow 09:30 PT to confirm required SAML attributes and KMS details. I'll update thread after repro verification. Tagging owners again: @arun.eng @neil.support @lina.finance. :thumbsup:
